Riley G: FYI — Vertex Labs reached out: they terminated their Dedicated instance early (effective 2026-12-10) but were charged for the full December month on INV-2026-12-01-VL. They want a prorated credit + correction for an overlapping promo applied twice. Can we handle?

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-12-01-VL posted 2026-12-01 06:50Z. Total: $48,760.00. Status: paid. PDF link: https://billing.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-2026-12-01-VL

Sam (Acct Rep): Customer DM'd a note: termination notice timestamp 2026-12-10 08:12Z. They expected a prorated charge for 10 days only. Also flagged promo DOUBLE-DEC being applied on both the recurring line and a one-time trial credit — net effect they were over-credited once then charged full month. Confusing.

Jun (Customer): pasted invoice fragment and contract excerpt:
```
lines:
1,Dedicated GPU - month,2026-12,1,45000.00,0.00,45000.00
2,One-time migration credit,-,1,-5000.00,0.00,-5000.00
3,PROMO DOUBLE-DEC applied,-,0,-4500.00,0.00,-4500.00
```
contract note: "Termination prorate: customer billed pro-rata for partial months."

Riley G: So system charged full 45k then subtracted promo 4.5k + migration credit 5k -> net 35.5k (plus tax/fees). If they should only be billed for 10/31 of month, prorated amount = 45,000 * 10/31 = 14,516.13. Then apply one promo only (per promo rules max one promo per invoice). Expected net = 14,516.13 - 5,000 (migration credit) - 4,500 (promo?) Wait, promo duplication is the issue — it seems promo was applied twice in two different forms leading to incorrect totals.

Sam (Acct Rep): I exported invoice lines from billing system and promo history: system applied PROMO DOUBLE-DEC as a line item and also applied trial credit which had the same value mistakenly. The promo rules say one promo per account per invoice. We double-counted.

Riley G: Quick math: prorated recurring = 14,516.13. One-time migration credit should still apply (-5,000). Promo should apply once; promo value is capped at 4,500. So expected total before tax = 14,516.13 - 5,000 - 4,500 = 5,016.13. Current posted net before tax was 35,500. Delta = 30,483.87 credit required (excludes tax).

Priya (Dir Finance): Thanks for the breakdown. Approve issuing a combined credit memo covering the overcharge and duplicate promo. Add adj code FIN-TERM-2026-558 and mark as goodwill for termination billing error. We need GL impact lines and confirmation of refund method.

Sam (Acct Rep): Proposal: create credit memo CM-2026-1810 amount -30,483.87 and adjust tax accordingly. Because customer paid by wire and asks for ACH refund, process an outgoing ACH for that amount once credit posts. Use payment ref ACH-2026-774. Also reissue invoice INV-2026-12-01-VL-R1 with prorated line and single promo.

Liam (Payments): Can do ACH refund after CM posts. Need beneficiary bank details (Jun confirmed DM with routing/account). Note ACH timing 2-3 business days; include bank fee reversal where applicable.

Sam (Acct Rep): Creating CM-2026-1810 now. GL: Revenue Contra 4010 -30,483.87; Tax Liability 2410 adjust based on posted tax. Notes: "Early termination prorate + duplicate promo removal. FIN-TERM-2026-558 attached."

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-1810 created and applied to INV-2026-12-01-VL. Amount posted: -30483.87. Status: pending_refund. Tax adjustment scheduled. Reference FIN-TERM-2026-558.

eng-billing-bot: Created billing bug BI-2026-627: root cause = promo engine allowed duplicate promo instances when one promo created via legacy trial-credit pipeline and again via new promo-service. Added unit test 'promo_dedup_overlap' and assigned to eng-billing.

Priya (Dir Finance): Confirm final posted balance will be $0.00 after credit and refund. Also require a short customer-facing explanation for legal. Finance will review wording.

Jun (Customer): Thanks — appreciate fast response. Please confirm ACH ref once sent.

Liam (Payments): ACH submitted 2026-12-16 15:40Z ref ACH-2026-774, bank confirmation: BC-9988. ETA 2 biz days.

billing-bot: CM-2026-1810 applied. Invoice INV-2026-12-01-VL new balance: $0.00. Refund ACH-2026-774 completed 2026-12-18 11:05Z.

Sam (Acct Rep): Reissued invoice INV-2026-12-01-VL-R1 attached to case and sent to customer. Closing once Jun confirms receipt in bank.

Jun (Customer): ACH posted — funds received. Thanks everyone.

Riley G: Adding BI-2026-627 to billing QA test plan. Closing thread.
